comment:
* 
 * 
 * This is a Duplicate Name Value List that will allow multiple values map to the same key.
 * 
 * The parsing and encoding logic for it is the same as that of NameValueList. Only the HashMap
 * container is different.
 * 
 * @author aayush.bhatnagar
 * @since 2.0
 *

methods.name: public String encode()
methods.comment:
* Encode the list in semicolon separated form.
     * 
     * @return an encoded string containing the objects in this list.
     * @since v1.0

methods.name: public void set(String name, Object value)
methods.comment: * Set a namevalue object in this list.

methods.name: public boolean equals(Object otherObject)
methods.comment:
* Compare if two NameValue lists are equal.
     * 
     * @param otherObject is the object to compare to.
     * @return true if the two objects compare for equality.

methods.name: public Object getValue(String name)
methods.comment: * Do a lookup on a given name and return value associated with it.

methods.name: public Collection getNameValue(String name)
methods.comment:
* Get the NameValue record given a name.
     *

methods.name: public boolean hasNameValue(String name)
methods.comment: * Returns a boolean telling if this NameValueList has a record with this name

methods.name: public boolean delete(String name)
methods.comment: * Remove the element corresponding to this name.

methods.name: public Iterator<NameValue> iterator()
methods.comment:
* Return an iterator for the name-value pairs of this list.
     * 
     * @return the iterator.

methods.name: public Iterator<String> getNames()
methods.comment:
* Get a list of parameter names.
     * 
     * @return a list iterator that has the names of the parameters.

methods.name: public String getParameter(String name)
methods.comment:
* Get the parameter as a String.
     * 
     * @return the parameter as a string.

methods.name: public NameValue put(String key, NameValue value)

methodNames: public void set(String name, Object value)
public NameValue put(String key, NameValue value)
